title: Realmz Providence Canonical Project
description: The versioned, persisted Providence project contract. The generated seam owns the top-level inventory plus migrated source, scenario-startup, map, map-record, random-level, scenario-item, treasure, shop, message, option-label, battle, and simple-encounter DTO families; remaining nested domain DTO schemas are incremental work.

canonicalObject.description: A canonical nested DTO whose field-level schema will be generated in a later slice.

origin.description: Authored projects compile from canonical data; imported projects may consult the compatibility annex.

rawSourcesDir.description: Compatibility-annex location. It is empty for normal authored projects.
